OrderRecord.title: OrderRecord
OrderRecord.description: A customer fountain pen and bottled ink purchase placed on PENS R US Kenya with live order tracking status.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the customer who placed the order.

userEmail.description: The email address of the authenticated user.

orderStatus.description: Current fulfillment and courier tracking status of the order.

trackingCode.description: Kenya courier tracking reference code, e.g. NBO-COUR-4821.

estimatedDelivery.description: Estimated delivery window or signed delivery confirmation note.

phone.description: Kenyan mobile number for courier and M-Pesa.

address.description: Building, road, or landmark delivery address.

paymentMethod.description: Settlement method: M-Pesa, Cash on Delivery, or WhatsApp Order Concierge.

promoCode.description: Applied promotional voucher code, if any.

promoDiscountKes.description: KES discount applied via promotional voucher.

bundleDiscountKes.description: KES discount applied via Iroshizuku Ink Mixing Set bundle.

items.description: Serialized list of purchased items with product, variant, nibSize, and quantity.

timestamp.description: Formatted date/time string when the order was placed.

ProductCatalogItem.title: ProductCatalogItem
ProductCatalogItem.description: A fountain pen, converter, or bottled ink item managed via the PENS R US Merchant Admin Console.

image.description: Primary product image path or URL.

variants.description: Available finishes or ink shade variants including stockCount.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when last edited.

StoreSettingsConfig.title: StoreSettingsConfig
StoreSettingsConfig.description: Global storefront bundle pricing, delivery threshold, and WhatsApp concierge configuration.

inkMixingSetBundleKes.description: Discounted bundle price in KES for the 3-bottle Iroshizuku Ink Mixing Set.

freeDeliveryThresholdKes.description: Order subtotal in KES required for complimentary nationwide courier.

whatsappConciergePhone.description: Nairobi Atelier WhatsApp phone number in international format.

PromoCode.title: PromoCode
PromoCode.description: A promotional discount code managed in the Merchant Admin Console and validated at checkout.

code.description: Uppercase promo code string entered by shoppers.

discountType.description: Whether the discount is a percentage (1-90) or fixed KES amount.

discountValue.description: Percentage value or fixed KES discount amount.

minSpendKes.description: Minimum cart subtotal in KES required to apply the voucher.

active.description: Whether the promo code is currently active or paused/expired.

ProductReview.title: ProductReview
ProductReview.description: A customer star rating and short review submitted for a PENS R US product.

productId.description: The ID of the reviewed product (e.g. pilot-prera).

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the reviewer.

authorLocation.description: City or neighborhood in Kenya (e.g. Westlands, Nairobi).

variantLabel.description: Reviewed finish or ink shade and nib size.

comment.description: Short written review of the product.

RestockAlert.title: RestockAlert
RestockAlert.description: A customer 'Notify Me' restock notification request for an out-of-stock product variant.

variantLabel.description: Display name of the out-of-stock variant.

nibSize.description: Requested nib size (Fine or Medium), if applicable.

contact.description: Customer email address or Kenyan phone number for restock alert.

userId.description: Optional Firebase UID if signed in.

status.description: Whether the customer is waiting for restock or has been notified.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer order history and live courier tracking records scoped to the authenticated owner or store admin.

/products/{productId}.description: Storefront product catalog, per-variant stock counts, and KES pricing managed by the Merchant Admin Console.

/store_settings/{settingId}.description: Global bundle pricing, delivery threshold, and WhatsApp concierge settings.

/promo_codes/{promoId}.description: Publicly readable promotional discount vouchers managed by the Merchant Admin Console.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Publicly readable customer star ratings and short reviews created by authenticated users.

/restock_alerts/{alertId}.description: Customer 'Notify Me' waitlist entries for out-of-stock variants, readable and manageable by the Merchant Admin.
